_about: Megatherium landmarks in the prepped Tripo mesh's own units (head to -Y, feet at z=0, 1 unit nose to tail tip). Leg joints below the belly are cross-section centroids at these heights; the rest are read off the grid render (docs/orchestration/reports/sp-megatherium/rig_landmarks.jpg).
